# Mystery Town

> Hardcore RP & zombies SA-MP server with deep economy, factions, and atmospheric lore. Survive the dead. Live the role.

Mystery Town runs on heavily modified SA-MP 0.3.7 R5 with hundreds of custom scripts: persistent properties, crafting, factions, dynamic infection, weather and a player-driven economy. Whitelist-only roleplay.
